registry:
<harness>_available	daemon	true	Whether this harness executable is available on PATH: true, false, or checking while the daemon reads the login environment.
<harness>_cap_<capability>	daemon	true	Whether this harness supports the named capability.
<harness>_executable	daemon	false	Executable for this harness. Empty finds the default executable on PATH.
activity.config	daemon	false	Session activity tracking configuration as JSON. Empty leaves no agent selected; activity requires a selected agent.
activity.enabled	daemon	false	Track session activity: true or false.
activity.intervals	daemon	false	Activity sampling intervals as JSON. Empty uses defaults.
activity.presence_idle_seconds	daemon	false	Seconds without input before presence becomes idle.
analytics.enabled	daemon	false	Record usage analytics on this home and its outposts: true or false. Experimental; off by default.
analytics.share_vents	daemon	false	Send each new attn vent, with its text, in the next upload: true or false. Off by default.
analytics.sharing_enabled	daemon	false	Upload the recorded usage analytics to attn's maintainers: true or false. Needs analytics.enabled; off by default.
analytics.tool_vents	daemon	false	Let new sessions also vent about their other tools, such as skills, other CLIs and harness permissions; tool vents never leave the machine: true or false. Off by default.
asks_enabled	daemon	false	Enable agent asks: true or false. On by default; applies to new agents.
auto_approve_enabled	daemon	false	Auto-approve supported agent requests: true or false.
auto_settle_arm_seconds	daemon	false	Delay before arming automatic settlement, in seconds. Empty uses the default delay.
auto_settle_countdown_seconds	daemon	false	Automatic settlement countdown, in seconds. Empty uses the default countdown.
auto_settle_enabled	daemon	false	Settle completed turns automatically: true or false.
callouts_enabled	daemon	false	Let agents point at the app interface: true or false.
capture.shortcut	daemon	false	Global shortcut for Quick Capture. Empty turns the shortcut off.
claude_executable	daemon	false	Executable for Claude. Empty finds the default executable on PATH.
claude_mod_enabled	daemon	false	Deliver input to Claude sessions through attn's Claude Code mod instead of typing: true or false. A session loads the mod at its next launch; turning this off goes back to typing at once.
codex_executable	daemon	false	Executable for Codex. Empty finds the default executable on PATH.
codex_shared_enabled	daemon	false	Use the shared Codex app server: true or false.
crew.autosleep_enabled	daemon	false	Put idle crew members to sleep automatically: true or false.
crew.away_seconds	daemon	false	Seconds of user inactivity before crew sleep.
crew.cache_ttl_seconds	daemon	false	Crew prompt cache lifetime in seconds.
crew.cache_ttl_seconds.<harness>	daemon	false	Crew prompt cache lifetime for this harness, in seconds.
crew.heartbeat_enabled	daemon	false	Send crew heartbeats: true or false.
crew.heartbeat_lead_seconds	daemon	false	Seconds before cache expiry to send a crew heartbeat.
crew.wake_limit	daemon	false	Maximum automatic crew wakes per window. Zero disables automatic wakes.
crew.wake_limit_window_seconds	daemon	false	Crew automatic wake accounting window in seconds.
db.last_backup_at	daemon	true	Time of the last database backup.
default_context_window_cap_<harness>	daemon	false	Context budget for new sessions, from 10000 to 2000000 tokens. Empty uses the harness default.
default_effort_<harness>	daemon	false	Reasoning effort for new sessions. Empty uses the harness default.
default_model_<harness>	daemon	false	Model for new sessions. Empty uses the harness default.
dictation.refinement_agent	daemon	false	Harness whose light model cleans up dictated text: claude or codex. Empty uses claude.
direct_agent_launch_enabled	daemon	false	Launch agents directly, without an attn process beside each one: true or false. On by default; applies to new and reloaded agents.
editor_executable	daemon	false	Command to open files in your editor. Empty uses the default editor.
garden.advisor	daemon	false	Garden advisor harness and model as JSON. Empty uses the default advisor.
garden.tender_wake	profile	false	Which seed mail wakes the closed session tending a seed on standby: any wakes it for every message, pull request watch update and reminder; watches only for pull request watch updates and reminders; off never resumes a session, and the mail waits. Crew members tending a seed wake under every value. Empty means any, the default.
gardenScale	daemon	false	Garden text scale, from 0.5 to 2.0. Empty uses the app scale.
headless_context_window_cap	daemon	false	Background model context budget in tokens, from 10000 to 2000000. Empty uses the default budget.
headless_tasks.enabled	daemon	false	Run background model tasks: true or false. An environment override takes precedence.
headless_tasks.enabled.override	daemon	true	Environment override for background model tasks.
headless_tasks.enabled.stored	daemon	true	Stored background model task switch.
keybindings_config	daemon	false	Keyboard shortcut overrides as JSON. Empty restores default shortcuts.
model_tier_overrides	daemon	false	Models for each intelligence tier as a JSON object. Empty uses harness defaults.
narrowest_tile_cols	daemon	false	Narrowest width of a tile in a desktop's row, in terminal columns: a positive whole number. Empty uses the default of 66.
new_session_agent	daemon	false	Harness selected for new sessions. Empty uses the default harness.
new_session_destination_<repository>	daemon	false	New session destination for a repository: new_worktree or main_repo. Use local_<absolute-path> as the suffix for this machine, or <outpost-id>_<absolute-path> for a repository on an outpost. Empty uses the default destination.
new_session_launcher_enabled	daemon	false	Show the new session launcher: true or false.
new_session_yolo_<location>	daemon	false	Start sessions at this location with approval bypass: true or false. The local location uses new_session_yolo_local.
nisse_enabled	daemon	false	Offer Nisse as a harness: true or false.
notebook.root	profile	false	This profile's folder for the Notebook, journal and seed artifacts, synced with outposts. Absolute or ~/ path. It must be outside attn's data folder, and neither inside nor around another profile's folder or the default folder. Changing it repoints without moving files. Empty uses the default folder.
notebook.root.effective	profile	true	The Notebook folder this profile uses.
notebook_sync_last_error	daemon	true	Current Notebook sync error and its reason.
notebook_sync_state	daemon	true	Current Notebook sync state on this machine.
open_sent_files_enabled	daemon	false	Open files sent by agents: true or false.
outpost_home	daemon	true	Recorded home daemon id. Release it with attn enrollment leave.
outpost_last_error	daemon	true	Last outpost bridge error, kept until the next successful connection.
outpost_state	daemon	true	Whether a home bridge is connected: bridged or off.
outposts_enabled	daemon	false	Connect to outposts from this home: true or false. Experimental; off by default.
phone_access_enabled	daemon	false	Let paired phones reach this home's sessions: true or false. Off by default.
projects_directory	daemon	false	Folder used to discover projects. Absolute or ~/ path; must not be empty.
pty_backend_mode	daemon	true	Active terminal backend.
pty_shared_host_active	daemon	true	Whether the shared terminal host is active.
pty_shared_host_enabled	daemon	false	Use the shared terminal host, and stream output only to terminals the window draws: true or false. On by default; applies to new and reloaded terminals.
pull_requests.own_comments	profile	false	How a pull request watch treats the comments and review bodies your GitHub account wrote, and the reopened review threads you started on your own pull requests: quiet skips them, ring delivers them to the agent. Agents post as you, so quiet keeps an agent's own comments from coming back to it; ring lets you steer agents with your comments. Comments by others and state changes always reach the agent. Empty means quiet, the default.
queue_crew_enabled	daemon	false	Include crew sessions in the queue: true or false.
queue_mode_enabled	daemon	false	Use queue flow across all profiles: true or false.
queue_quiet_notifications	daemon	false	Keep agents a notification woke out of the queue unless they open their turn: true or false. On by default; needs queue flow.
queue_show_hidden_sessions	daemon	false	Include hidden sessions in the queue: true or false. On by default.
quick_capture_enabled	daemon	false	Enable the experimental Quick Capture panel: true or false. Changes to agent guidance apply at their next launch.
reviewer_model	daemon	false	Review model. Empty uses the default review model.
session_cost.billed_as.<model>	daemon	false	Billing model alias. Empty removes the alias.
session_cost.price.<model>	daemon	false	Custom model token prices as JSON. Empty uses catalog prices.
sessions.filters	daemon	false	Saved ledger filters as JSON. Empty restores default filters.
sidebar_harness_logos_enabled	daemon	false	Show harness logos in the sidebar: true or false.
sidebar_width	daemon	false	Width of the open sidebar in pixels, from 200 to 600. Empty uses the default of 240.
theme	daemon	false	App color theme: dark, light or system.
tile_popout_enabled	daemon	false	Let tiles pop out of the main window into their own windows: true or false. Off by default.
uiScale	daemon	false	App interface scale, from 0.5 to 2.0.
worktree_sweep_enabled	daemon	false	Remove unused worktrees automatically: true or false.
